0.speaker: Eliab
0.text: David! Why have you come down here? With whom did you leave those few sheep in the wilderness?

1.speaker: Eliab
1.text: I know your pride and the mischief of your heart -- you came only to watch the battle.

2.speaker: Eliab
2.text: ...Go on, then. Goliath waits beyond the brook. Not one man among us dares to face him.
